2. The Liquidity Coverage Ratio is a key component within Basel III, ensuring that banks maintain enough liquid assets relative to their short-term liabilities under stress conditions without causing undue harm to the economy by using wholesale deposits with a run -off rate of 35 per cent for those less than six months in duration.
